entities.summary: Elizabeth Adjei is a Ghanaian diplomat. In September 2002, she was appointed as director of the Ghana Immigration Service, making her the first woman to occupy such a position. She has served as Ghana's Ambassador to Spain, a position she held from 2015 to 2020.
